item.title: Connacht move into playoff spots
item.description: Connacht have moved into the playoff spots in the URC this evening. The Westerners beat Glasgow Warriors 15-10 at Dexcom Stadium thanks to a late Sean Jansen try. The hosts are up to 8th for now at least. Advertisement Munster host Zebre, hoping to avoid four defeats in a row at Thomond Park - that's underway at half 5. They're a quarter-to-8 start to Ulster's trip to Ospreys.

item.title: Liverpool go fifth
item.description: Liverpool have thrashed West Ham 5-2 to go fifth in the Premier League. Brentford scored late to beat Burnley 4-3 after being 3-0 up and Everton were 3-2 winners at Newcastle. It was 1-all in the early game between Bournemouth and Sunderland. Advertisement Erling Haaland is injured for Manchester City's trip to Leeds this evening. That one is underway at 5:30pm Coventry scored in the 94th minute to beat Stoke 2-1 and move eight points clear at the top of the Championship. Advertisement Millwall'

item.title: Status yellow rain warning in place from midnight
item.description: A status yellow rain warning will be in place for the county from midnight. Met Éireann is warning of localised flooding, poor visibility, and hazardous travelling conditions The warning was issued this morning and will remain in place until midnight on Monday. Advertisement The warning is also in place for counties Galway and Mayo.

item.title: Verdict of accidental death at inquest of Kerry rally driver who died in Clare in 2023
item.description: The coroner in Clare has delivered a verdict of accidental death at the inquest of a Kerry man who died during the Clare Stages Rally in 2023. The inquest took place into the death of 37-year-old Damien Fleming, who died from multiple injuries after a car crashed into Mr Fleming’s stationary car during the rally in September 2023. The inquest heard Mr Fleming, a navigator, and his co-driver Nigel Creagh, had pulled in due to mechanical difficulties but there was only room for one car on the road
